name: VR-prep
definition: VR-prep is a workflow for image transformation and data harmonization designed to expedite and optimize the 3D rendering of medical imaging data (DICOM series) for display in Augmented Reality (AR) on smartphones, specifically for the 'Medical Imaging XR' (MIXR) application. It reduces file size and processing time without sacrificing image quality or readability, and extends MIXR's native support (CT only) to MRI, US, PET-CT, and microscopy data.
summary: VR-prep is a preprocessing workflow that standardizes medical imaging data for AR volume rendering by enforcing isotropic resolution and correcting intensity inversions.
